title: James Webb discovers a scorching lava planet with a “giant sunscreen”
caption:
Astronomers found a scorching exoplanet that shouldn't have an atmosphere, yet it does. Observations from the James Webb Space Telescope suggest it's using a layer of mineral clouds as a giant sunscreen to survive intense starlight.

Source: Sciencedaily - James Webb discovers a scorching lava planet with a “giant sunscreen”
